name: Misaki Nagisa
source:
Likes: Badminton, cute videos
Dislikes: Sloppy behavior

Class 3-A. A very talented girl who is a member of the cute movie club, the badminton club's ace player an also the student council president. Because she loves cute girls, she joined the cute movie club in order to catch their overwhelming cuteness in pictures. Nagisa is almost considered a queen and practically worshiped by almost all of the girls in the school.
